events.title: Community Spotlight: User Experience
events.summary: In this spotlight video we cover the interface, trading, and display changes in Demo Update 1.0.10, shaped by your feedback. Quick-moved items now go to the most appropriate bag first, while trading has been expanded. On the display side, we've added DLSS and FSR support as well as the ability to adjust gamma and brightness to suit different screens.Please keep sharing your feedback in the Community Discord so that we can continue with improving the game.Sincerely, Antediluvian Interactive

events.title: Thank You For 400,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We're excited to share that we've hit another huge milestone: 400,000 wishlists! Just a few moments ago we were celebrating 300,000, and now we're already here.Every one of those wishlists came from someone deciding to give this game a shot—from booting up the demo, to posting a clip, or telling a friend to check it out. You are the reason we get to keep building Expedition: Into Darkness.This milestone belongs to you, thank you all.Try out the Demo today and leave us a review:Sincerely, Antedil

events.title: Weapons & Combat Guide
events.summary: Check out our latest video, where we're taking a deep dive into weapons: from choosing between blades, spears and bows, to understanding how side swings, overheads and thrusts each shine in different spaces. We also break down damage types and how they interact with the different enemy types.If you have already played the demo, make sure to leave us a review here on Steam! We'd love to hear your opinions and it helps us with further work on the game.Sincerely,Antediluvian Interactive

events.title: Community Spotlight: Optimisation
events.summary: In this spotlight video we cover the main changes from our latest patch. We've focused heavily on performance and stability, fixing VRAM usage,alongside bug fixes for loot spots in the Moor and Library. We’ve also added new wood resources, crafting options like the Fur Bonnet, and updated visual effects for a better atmosphere.Please keep sharing your feedback in the Community Discord so that we can continue with improving the game.Sincerely, Antediluvian Interactive

events.title: Getting Started in Expedition: Into Darkness
events.summary: New to the game? Here’s everything you need to know before your first run. Gear UpBefore heading out, open your inventory, it is located at the “characters” tab in the nav bar. Equip everything you’ll need: weapons, healing items, bags. Drag items into the right slots to get set up! The correct slot for the item lights green for when it is empty, yellow when you can swap an item and Red when you can’t equip it or when it’s the wrong slot.
